title: 2 Leather Pieces That Get Better the Longer You Own Them
description: Two everyday leather pieces from Bellroy: the Hide & Seek Premium slim billfold with a hidden bill section, and the ultra-slim Card Sleeve.
intro: Good leather is one of the few things that looks better at year five than on the day you bought it. It softens, darkens and takes the shape of the way you use it.
These two are small, used every day, and chosen for the leather first and the logo last.

picks.name: Bellroy Hide & Seek Premium Edition
picks.kicker: The slim billfold with a secret
picks.alt: Bellroy Hide & Seek Premium Edition slim leather billfold in black
paras: Four quick-access slots hold the cards you use most, and a flat section behind them keeps extra cards without the bulk. At 115 by 85 mm it slips into a front trouser pocket.

The detail only you will know about: a hidden section at the back keeps large bills and a coin pouch out of sight. The Premium Edition uses exclusively sourced leather and contrast stitching — refinement you feel before you see it.
picks.verdict: the man whose wallet is too thick to sit on comfortably.

picks.name: Bellroy Card Sleeve
picks.kicker: Everything you need, nothing you do not
picks.alt: Bellroy Card Sleeve leather card holder in black
paras: The Card Sleeve holds two to eight cards and a few folded bills in a piece of leather just 7 mm thick. Two quick-draw slots sit on the outside; a pull tab brings up the rest.
Why it feels special: it is nothing but leather and stitching — no bulky linings. Bellroy sources its leather from tanneries rated gold by the Leather Working Group.
picks.verdict: evenings out, travel, or a second wallet for the essentials.

closing: Buy the leather, not the logo. A small piece used every day will earn its price many times over.
